title: The Shepherd and the Sea
summary: A shepherd sold his flock to buy a ship laden with dates. A violent storm wrecked his vessel, leaving him destitute....
full_text:
A shepherd sold his flock to buy a ship laden with dates. A violent storm wrecked his vessel, leaving him destitute.

Returning to sheep-herding, he sat upon the cliffs on a calm, sunny day, gazing at the tranquil sea.

He warned his lambs: "Look at her smiling ripples! She pretends to be peaceful, but she is merely thirsting for another cargo of dates!"
moral: Do not trust the smiling calm of a sea that has once swallowed your fortunes.
